Home / Partner records

Partner records

Registration, certifications and remittance

About this section

The partner records section holds everything the vendor network keeps about a registered company: the registration itself, any certifications lodged with the records office, and the remittance details used for payment. Records are maintained per season.

Available areas

Registration — open to unauthenticated applicants. Submit Form PR-2 to register a company contact for the 2026 season.

Certifications and Remittance — require partner credentials. Sign in to continue; credentials are issued by the records office after a registration is accepted.

Questions about the state of an existing record go to the records office.
